note: Council Resolution 4205-05-2013 (approved May 21, 2013) canvassed the general election held May 11, 2013. It recites that the City Secretary certified unopposed candidacy for Mayor on March 19, 2013. Under Texas Election Code section 2.053, Ordinance 20657-03-2013 declared the unopposed mayoral candidate elected and canceled the mayoral election. Section 6 of the resolution names Betsy Price as declared elected to the office of Mayor. No mayoral votes were cast. The year is recorded as complete with the scheduled election date and a winner only. Text was read from the Laserfiche portal text layer (pages 1 to 3).
